summary: Toyota Motor Credit Corporation filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing the one-year renewal of its Euro Medium Term Note Programme effective September 11, 2026. TMCC and affiliates Toyota Motor Finance (Netherlands) B.V., Toyota Credit Canada Inc. and Toyota Finance Australia Limited act as issuers, sharing a 60 billion aggregate authorized outstanding amount. Notes are unsecured, issuable in bearer or registered form, with The Bank of New York Mellon as agency provider; Regulation S notes are unregistered. This is a routine debt-program maintenance filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation or premium apply. Watch only for future drawdown pricing.
